summary: All 54 phase-specific tests pass (26 db + 11 media + 17 ui). go vet and go build exit 0. Implementation covers all spec acceptance criteria: 4 built-in presets (YouTube 1080p, Podcast Audio, Archive, Web Preview), preset selection in export dialog, custom preset creation/persistence, stream-copy decision logic, and settings panel management. No missing behavior, shallow tests, stubs masking production gates, fake-harness issues, artifact-only tests claiming live behavior, or intentionally-red tests in aggregate suites. Two pre-existing flaky tests (TestAutoSaveService_AutoSaveOnInterval, TestCreateBackup_CreatesConsistentSnapshotWithConcurrentWrites) fail intermittently under concurrent SQLite load but pass in isolation — not related to this track. Minor documentation issue: plan.md references Phase 1 commit as 4c2826d but actual commit is 3ca9cac (Phase 2 bb032a8 and Phase 3 f103cca are correct). Live GNOME visual verification is a manual gate deferred to human reviewer per plan.
